text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali, in a speech at the annual meeting of diplomats on Friday, urged the international community to work "actively and firmly" to save peace in the Middle East.
- French Foreign Affairs Minister Hubert Vedrine to start an official two-day visit to Tunisia on Monday.

- Tunisia's state-run Societe Tunisienne de l'Electricite et du Gaz (STEG,) signed a cooperation accord on Friday with the Mauritanian water and power company, Societe Nationale des Eaux et de l'Electricite (SONELEC).
